districts.intro: One master community · Eight island districts

overview.title: A waterfront community taking shape in Dubailand
paragraphs: DAMAC Islands 2 brings villas and townhouses into a water-led master plan in Dubailand. The proposition is straightforward: larger homes, a broad amenity programme and a suburban setting connected to Dubai's main road network.

Eight island themes give the districts their individual identity. Across them, the plan combines lagoons, landscaped parks, walking routes and family recreation. Buyers should consider that environment alongside the 2029 handover horizon and the scale of the wider community.
